notes.title: New Build Released
notes.content:
Hello Coffee fiends!

We just released a new Coffence build with loads of new features for you to try out.

Here's a short list of what's new: 
[list]
    [*]Story Mode with unlockables
    [*]New Levels: Cocoa Beach and Supremo Office
    [*]Two new characters: Mocca the caffeinated Canine and the mysterious Cupernicus.
    [*]Six new cups to unlock!
    [*]Completely Remade menu, character and cup select.
    [*]Complete rework of pretty much every system.
    [*]New mechanic: Perfect Block. Release block right before impact to deal damage to the attacker.
[/list]

It's been a long road to get here, but we now have a very solid foundation to iterate and continue our work on the game.

We are heading to PAX West this week, so expect some smaller updates with bugfixes through the week as we stabilize the game as much as possible.

Thank you for your patience, and we hope you enjoy this new build!

-The Sweet Bandits

notes.title: Instant Rematch, D-Pad Controls and BRAWL mode upgrades!
notes.content:
Hey there Coffencers! Hope you had a great week. We have just released our latest build to live which comes with a bunch of upgrades as well as tweaks and fixes. Here’s a quick overview of what’s new:

[h1] New Brawl Maps Layout [/h1] We changed the layout for Brawl’s Mother Bean level and added some new platforms on brawl’s version of pirates of the Carabean. We are playing with the idea of added verticality and we will iterate on it more in the coming updates. Be warned that AI currently have a hard time with platforming, but this should be fixed soon!

[h1] Instant Rematch [/h1]You can now settle the score with your friends without waiting for a pesky loading screen between matches. We also keep the total number of victories for players between matches as a small bonus.

[h1] D-Pad Controls [/h1] A much requested feature from our time at EVO! You can now use the D-Pad for character movements.

[h1] Coffee Break Tweaks [/h1] We changed the input for the coffee break and we now prevent players from drinking more coffee when already powered. Coffee drops also freeze correctly in the air during the coffee break animation now.

[h1] Different Character Skins [/h1]When players choose the same characters, they will have a different color scheme to help differentiate players even more.

[h1] Collision Improvements [/h1] Our previous collisions could create some awkward situations when players where to close to each other. Hits would sometime not connect with your enemy because the attack was going past the opponent’s cup.

[h1] Audio Options [/h1]You can tweak multiple sound channels individually in the option menu.

We also fixed a freeze that could occur in the main menu and many other smaller bugs all around. We hope you enjoy this new release and don’t forget to report any issue you might discover with this new patch. Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Aiming Reticle and Gameplay Progress
notes.content:
Hey there Coffencers! We got a big new update coming today that continues our work on making the gameplay of Coffence clearer, more fun and more polished overall. We got new feedbacks, balancing tweaks and an aiming reticle all coming in with this update. Let’s take a closer look!

[h1] Details:[/h1]

[b]Added an aiming reticle:[/b] This is something we got asked about a few times and we think it makes the whole targeting aspect of Coffence much more intuitive. Give us your feedback!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27573581/5dc44469f2afddde07fb48f53159ea10ef82c0fe.jpg[/img]


[b] Coffee Break Overhaul:[/b] Coffee Break was kind of an obscure mechanic in the past. We added some much need feedback when someone uses it in the form of an animation and some awesome effects. We will add to the Coffee Break in the coming updates.

[b]Blocking Feedback:[/b] Blocking now has its own animation and plays a distinct sound. This should help clarify what happened when someone pulls off a last-minute block.

[b]Characters work:[/b] New VFX, New Sound effects and more differentiation for characters. This is still ongoing but should already be a big step up from previous versions.

[b]Bug Fixing:[/b] As always, we fixed a lot of issues all over the place that should make the game more enjoyable overall.

We think this update is a big step toward making Coffence easier to play but also deeper in it’s underlying mechanics. As always, tell us what you like or dislike about the latest advancements in the forum or below this announcement!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Gameplay Rework and Tutorials!
notes.content:
Hello Coffencers!  We have a juicy new update for you today: We have a Basic and Advanced tutorial, gameplay rework for the melee attack, new visual effects for clearer feedback, rebalancing of cups and a beginning of stats differentiation for characters among many fixes and tweaks. 

[h1]Here’s the detailed change list[/h1]

[list]
 [*][b]Added Tutorial menu with both basic and advanced tutorials.	[/b]Added 
 [*][b] Melee Attack rework:[/b] You now drive forward while attacking. The length of the attack depends on how long you hold the melee button. You can also chain together melee attacks for a quick combo.
[*][b]Cups Rebalancing:[/b] Following player feedback, we changed some of the cups stats and narrowed the gap between the smallest cup to the biggest in term of coffee capacity.
[*][b]Character Differentiation start:[/b] We have started giving different stats to characters including jump height, dash speed, walk speed, number of successive melee attack and melee attack range among other.
[*][b]New VFX for clearer feedback on many attacks and actions.[/b] 
[*][b]You can now drop down from platforms in BRAWL by holding downward and A or Shift on keyboard.[/b] 
[*][b]Every player can now pause and control the pause menu.[/b]  
[*][b]Many small bugs fix all around for a smoother experience.[/b] 
[/list]


That’s it for today. We are still completely focused on reworking the aspects of the gameplay that need polish and better feedback. You can expect to see more of this very soon.

Enjoy!

notes.title: AI update is in!
notes.content:
Do you tend to enjoy your coffee in solo? We got great news for you! We just released AI fighters for coffence. You can now brush up your skills in single player with 10 different AI skill levels over both DUEL and BRAWL mode.  Let’s take a look at everything new in this update:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27573581/8e0b3ce20be9cc6661053db417d9e64924aefdad.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]AI fighters have been added with 10 skill levels. 
    [*]Main menu rework for a clearer experience and to accommodate the integration of AI fighters.
    [*]VFX rework across the board to fit with our art style.
    [*]New result screens in all modes and intro screens in DUEL
    [*]A coffeepot load of bug fixes from physics crashes to match management issues. The game should be much more stable overall.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27573581/fe33069d93fc2ef0445787283ce33f9732c14e73.jpg[/img]
Of course we are not done working on the AI and you should notice considerable improvements to it’s behavior in the next few weeks. For now, the AI fighters are locked to random characters and the basic cup, but we want to give you control of their loadouts very soon. We hope you enjoy this new way to play Coffence and don’t hesitate to leave your feeback in the forums!


Enjoy!

notes.title: 4 Players action in all-new BRAWL MODE!
notes.content:
Hey there Coffencers! We are back with our biggest, boldest, most caffeine infused update yet: [b]THE BRAWL UPDATE[/b].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27573581/5f1157a01e1fdda8b69f28c2347855162f68503f.jpg[/img]


There is a lot of changes to cover but we’ll focus on the biggest new features in this post:

[list]
    [*]BRAWL mode is in! You can now play Coffence with 4 players for    complete coffee mayhem. 
    [*]New BLEND RUNNER level made specifically for BRAWL as well as new variants of Pirates of the Carabean and the Mother Bean for 4 player play.
    [*]Captain Puccino joins the cast as our latest playable character.
    [*]New character models for both Ryan and Kent.
    [*]All-new prettier, smoother, more user-friendly menu to make getting into the game a pleasant experience.
    [*]Cups and visual effects are now color coded according to which player has them to make the action clearer.
[/list]

This also comes with many smaller changes across the board to make the game a more polished experience.

With this huge update out of the way, we have put in place many of the building blocks we need to push Coffence forward and develop new content at a brisk pace. You can expect some new updates pretty soon to build upon what we started here.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Build: The Cupdate!
notes.content:
Hey there fellow Coffencers and thanks for following us into Early Access! Ever since we started this project, we wanted to deliver quick content updates and we aim to start delivering on this promise with this update that we aptly named: [b] THE CUPDATE![/b]

[h1]What's new?[/h1]


[b]Cup Selection:[/b] You can now select from 6 different cup types, each presenting their own handling and coffee capacity. Will you go for the espresso cup and it's ultra-fast  speed at the cost of having only one drop of coffee? Or do you prefer bringing a coffee pot to a cup fight, giving you tremendous coffee capacity? The choice is now yours! We plan on balancing the different cups further and adding even more quirks to differentiate them.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27573581/7c1ca0a83b65780f3327354c17d267c1aa93248a.jpg[/img]


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We squashed a bunch of issues ranging from physics crashes to matches not ending properly on a tie. We still got plenty of issues we want to tackle next week, but this is a good start toward making Coffence more polished.


Hope you enjoy this first content drop! Of course this is far from the end. You can expect new exciting things from us in the very near future. For now, choose your cup and get Coffencing!

-The Sweet Bandits

notes.title: Welcome to Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey there Coffee fans! Welcome to Early Access! 

We wanted to thank all of you for your support from greenlight to this point, it has been invaluable in our quest for coffee based greatness. 


What you get today is a beginning in many ways. If you buy Coffence right now, you do not get a polished demo, you are getting an actual game in development with all the bugs and missing features it entails. What you also get is a special occasion to shape the game along with us. We want your feedback, your bug reports and your most wanted features so we can align our priorities with yours.

What you get today is a Local Multiplayer only game, but this will change over time. We have a pretty extensive roadmap of what we want to get into the game over the coming months and we are ready to share some of this with you right now. Of course, our main priority in the coming days will be to clear any major issues you guys come up with in the first build, new content will come afterward.

[h1]Here’s our roadmap at a high level: [/h1]

1-Address bugs and crashes to improve the game’s stability and performance.
•	E.g. Performance drops or client experience
2-Improve existing game content and add new features.
•	E.g. Adding new characters, adding new coffee based powers, adding new cups, twitch features, achievements and adding our new animations.
3-Develop brand new features
•	E.g. 4 player mayhem, 4 player party mode.


That’s the gist of our approach to the game’s development; stabilizing the game, improving the in-game experience, and offering brand new content for our fans! We also want our community to be a part of Coffence. You have a good idea for a coffee power? You would like to see a new Cup in the game? Any idea, good or bad, can always lead to a brilliant new idea. Do not hesitate to share it with the team.
Thanks a lot for joining us on this adventure. The road ahead might be bumpy from time to time, but we are certain that together we can make Coffence a great game. So grap a cup, brew yourself a nice coffee and jump in. We’ve got work to do!

[h1]-The Sweet Bandits [/h1]
